tools.name: orangepro_start
tools.description: One-command local setup for a repo or PR: analyze sources, auto-apply weak AI candidate links and candidate flows when a real BYOK provider is configured, write behavior-coverage.html (detailed report), short_behavior-coverage.html (summary), tests.csv + rtm.md, summarize changed/gap targets, and return agent next actions. When nothing changed since the last run it returns at once with unchanged_since and reuses the reports (fresh=true forces a full run). AI lanes stay separate and never affect Proven coverage.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

source.description: Source path to analyze. Defaults to workspace.

base_ref.description: Optional PR/diff base ref. Default auto-detects main/master when possible.

include_markdown.description: Enrich requirements-like Markdown docs. Default true.

generate_coverage.description: Run safe local coverage generation before analyze where supported. Default false.

no_ai.description: Disable automatic AI weak-link and candidate-flow passes even if a provider key is configured.

no_ai_flows.description: Disable automatic AI candidate-flow discovery while keeping weak AI links enabled.

ai_all.description: Run AI weak-linking over all deterministic behavior nodes instead of gaps-only.

provider.description: BYOK provider override for the AI passes.

prompt_version.description: Opt-in generation strategy for the auto-prove generation lane. Default v2/deterministic; v5 uses batched two-phase generation. The prove/mint gate is unchanged either way.

fresh.description: Run in full even when nothing changed since the last run. By default an unchanged repository returns at once with unchanged_since and the reports of the last run.

tools.name: orangepro_analyze_sources
tools.description: Build or refresh the local OrangePro evidence graph from a local checkout/path plus optional CSV/Markdown enrichers. Metadata-only by default — reads source in-process but never stores or uploads code. Optionally stages/applies AI candidate flows and refreshes the report when ai_flows=true.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

paths.description: Extra template/doc files (.csv/.md) to enrich the graph.

include_markdown.description: Enrich requirements-like Markdown docs. Default true.

ai_flows.description: Generate and apply AI-suggested candidate flows after analyze, then refresh the behavior report. Requires a BYOK provider; skips without failing analyze if none is configured.

mode.description: Persistence privacy mode. Only metadata_only is supported.

include_source_snippets.description: Deferred: source snippets are never persisted in the first slice.

tools.name: orangepro_graph_score
tools.description: Return the local graph readiness score (0-100), band, per-dimension breakdown, and plain-language missing evidence. Readiness signal, not a proof of test lift.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

tools.name: orangepro_status
tools.description: Show local workspace state without generating anything: whether the graph is fresh/stale/missing, source mix, score, and privacy settings (always local, no upload).

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

tools.name: orangepro_doctor
tools.description: Recommend the smallest next source that would most improve generated-test quality, with expected score impact. Teaches what data improves output.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

proof.description: Proof-focused mode: explain why top targets are not Dynamically Proven (deduped blockers + smallest next steps). Read-only; mints nothing.

tools.name: orangepro_find_test_gaps
tools.description: List requirements/flows with weak or missing test evidence, plus top_risk_gaps for unproven code symbols ranked by the OrangePro Risk Score (Probability × Impact × DetectionDifficulty). Risk is prioritization only; it never changes coverage/proof status.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

tools.name: orangepro_record_run
tools.description: Record an agent test-writing attempt as static diagnostics. When test_path is provided for TS/JS, OrangePro first tries scoped deterministic re-prove; otherwise it re-analyzes the repo. Static hard COVERS edges render as Associated signal; public Proven requires orangepro_prove.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

target_symbol.description: Exact CodeSymbol external id, e.g. sym:svc/add.go#Add. Preferred.

target_id.description: Optional graph target id that must resolve to exactly one hard-linked CodeSymbol.

source.description: Source checkout to re-analyze. Defaults to workspace.

test_path.description: Workspace-relative test file the agent just wrote. Enables scoped deterministic re-prove for TS/JS.

agent_pass.description: Whether the agent-reported test command passed. Advisory only.

vacuous.description: Whether the agent judged the test vacuous/non-assertive. Advisory only.

evidence_ids.description: Generated-test/evidence ids tied to this attempt. Metadata only.

provider.description: Model provider used by the agent/generator, if any.

model.description: Model name used by the agent/generator, if any.

prompt_version.description: Prompt or workflow version used, if any.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied run id. Defaults to a local monotonic id.

tools.name: orangepro_prove
tools.description: Run the dynamic targeted-proof oracle for a CodeSymbol and append a metadata-only ledger certificate. Public Proven closes only when baseline green plus a valid sentinel mutation of the credited symbol fails the same test at an assertion. Static record_run is diagnostics only.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

target_symbol.description: Exact CodeSymbol external id, e.g. sym:src/service.ts#OrderService.createOrder. Preferred.

target_id.description: Optional graph target id that must resolve to exactly one hard-linked CodeSymbol.

source.description: Source checkout containing the test and target files. Defaults to workspace.

test_path.description: TS/JS: repo-relative test file to run (required for TS/JS targets).

test_run.description: Go: fully-anchored test name for `go test -run`, e.g. '^TestCompute$' (required for Go targets). Java: 'TestClass#testMethod', e.g. 'CalculatorTest#addsTwoNumbers' (required for Java targets).

replacement.description: TS/JS: inert sentinel body, e.g. 'return null;' or 'return {"ok":false};'. Must be JSON-only per the oracle (required for TS/JS targets). Go derives its own sentinel.

target_file.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the file derived from target_symbol.

method.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the member derived from target_symbol.

link_node_modules.description: Trusted-repo speed mode: symlink node_modules into temp copies.

test_env.description: Explicit non-secret KEY=value env entries for the test run.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied run id. Defaults to a local monotonic id.

tools.name: orangepro_prove_loop
tools.description: Product wrapper around orangepro_prove: run trusted-local setup_commands in the source checkout, then the UNCHANGED dynamic targeted-proof oracle, then refresh the behavior report. Setup is non-secret repo prep only (build/install/shim); a setup failure returns unrunnable, does not run the oracle, and leaves the ledger untouched (never Proven). Public Proven still closes only through the unchanged certificate.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

target_symbol.description: Exact CodeSymbol external id, e.g. sym:src/service.ts#OrderService.createOrder. Preferred.

target_id.description: Optional graph target id that must resolve to exactly one hard-linked CodeSymbol.

source.description: Source checkout containing the test and target files. Setup runs here. Defaults to workspace.

test_path.description: TS/JS: repo-relative test file to run (required for TS/JS targets).

test_run.description: Go: fully-anchored test name for `go test -run`, e.g. '^TestCompute$' (required for Go targets). Java: 'TestClass#testMethod', e.g. 'CalculatorTest#addsTwoNumbers' (required for Java targets).

replacement.description: TS/JS: inert sentinel body, e.g. 'return null;' or 'return {"ok":false};'. Must be JSON-only per the oracle (required for TS/JS targets). Go derives its own sentinel.

target_file.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the file derived from target_symbol.

method.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the member derived from target_symbol.

link_node_modules.description: Trusted-repo speed mode: symlink node_modules into temp copies.

test_env.description: Explicit non-secret KEY=value env entries for the test run.

command.description: Executable to run in the source checkout, e.g. 'npm'.

setup_commands.description: Trusted-local repo prep run in the source checkout before the oracle. Non-secret only (build/install/shim). First non-zero exit returns unrunnable.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied run id. Defaults to a local monotonic id.

tools.name: orangepro_stats
tools.description: Summarize the local gap-fill ledger: attempted, dynamic-reproven, unproven, legacy static-associated, generated-but-unverifiable, and kept rate. Metadata-only.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

tools.name: orangepro_rtm
tools.description: Write and return a deterministic Requirements Traceability Matrix. Status comes only from the local graph and gap-fill ledger: Proven, Runtime-covered, Associated signal, No integration signal, Reproven, or Generated-unverifiable. No LLM calls.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

base_ref.description: Optional PR/diff scope. Restricts rows to behaviors touched vs this ref.

limit.description: Optional max rows to emit. Markdown defaults to 500 rows; JSON/CSV are uncapped unless set.

tools.name: orangepro_update_graph
tools.description: Refresh the local graph from changed files. Incremental and non-destructive by default — preserves evidence and marks affected generated tests stale.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

force_full_rebuild.description: Force a full rebuild instead of an incremental update.

tools.name: orangepro_changed_impact
tools.description: DIFF/PR TOOL — only for real code-review situations. Summarizes what changed vs a base git ref and which local graph behaviors/tests are affected (basic changed-file impact; no deep route/API shape analysis). Requires a git repo and a real diff: returns status 'no_diff' / 'no_code_changes' (diff was docs-only) / 'missing_base_ref' / 'not_a_git_repo' with guidance instead of fabricated impact when there is nothing to analyze. For baseline (no-PR) test opportunities use orangepro_find_test_gaps.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

base_ref.description: Base git ref to diff against. Default 'main'.

tools.name: orangepro_ai_links
tools.description: Opt-in AI lane: propose weak MAY_RELATE_TO candidate links between existing deterministic behavior and CodeSymbol nodes. Generate writes .orangepro/ai/links.json only; apply=true explicitly merges survivors into candidate_edges. These links never affect proven coverage.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

apply.description: Apply staged links into candidate_edges. Default false stages links only.

all.description: Link across all behavior nodes instead of the default gaps-only scope.

max_behaviors.description: Maximum behavior targets to process in this AI linking run.

symbols_per_behavior.description: Deterministic CodeSymbol shortlist size per behavior.

tools.name: orangepro_ai_flows
tools.description: Opt-in AI lane: propose candidate behavior-flow chains over existing deterministic entry and CodeSymbol ids. Generate writes .orangepro/flows.json only; apply=true stores survivors under analysis.candidate_flows. Candidate flows are a verify-these worklist and never affect Proven, deterministic flow counts, tiers, or coverage.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

apply.description: Apply staged flows into analysis.candidate_flows. Default false stages flows only.

tools.name: orangepro_generate_tests
tools.description: Generate a small capped set (1-5) of grounded tests from local evidence using your own model key (BYOK: OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, or Anthropic). Tests are diversified across lightweight LOCAL scenario buckets (happy_path, validation_error, edge_case, integration_flow, security_privacy, regression) chosen from the evidence — unjustified buckets are skipped, never padded. By default it focuses the top-gap behavior and returns up to `limit` bucket-diverse tests for it; pass multiple target_ids to split the budget across them. Each test reports its bucket plus VALIDATED grounding `evidence` (every cited entity resolved against the local graph with its kind, evidence strength, and source_ref) and discloses weak/candidate evidence; `evidence_summary` reports proof coverage and any broken citations, so the grounding is verifiable rather than asserted. If evidence is too thin, returns missing-evidence guidance instead of generic tests. Returns each test's code plus `run_hints` (a suggested file path + run command) and an `agent_workflow`: YOU (the agent) write each file and run it with your shell tools, then report pass/fail + stack traces — OrangePro never writes to or runs anything in the repo. Requires the repo's test framework/deps to already be installed.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

target_ids.description: Behavior/requirement external ids to target. Default: the top-gap behavior. Pass several to split the budget across them (each gets a test when the budget allows, in priority order).

base_ref.description: PR-scoped generation: restrict to the behaviors the diff vs this ref touches (e.g. 'main') — for branch/PR review, target only the changed code. Requires a git repo + a real diff; returns structured guidance (status + guidance) instead of fabricating when there is none. Overrides target_ids.

limit.description: Total tests to generate (1-5), spread across local scenario buckets. Default 3.

provider.description: BYOK provider override (auto-detected from env if omitted). Use 'deterministic' for an offline stand-in; without any provider configured, generation returns setup guidance instead of degrading.

prompt_version.description: Prompt strategy. Defaults to v2; v5 is opt-in until corpus validation clears it as default.

write_files.description: Deferred/premium: repo file writing is disabled in the first slice; always treated as false.

compare.description: Run BOTH arms — prompt-only baseline vs Local KG, same model + system prompt — and return side-by-side scores (completeness, context awareness, accuracy, domain specificity) plus both test suites. Non-persisting testing view.

tools.name: orangepro_explain_test
tools.description: Explain why a generated test exists: which graph evidence anchors support it, source refs, and whether weak/candidate evidence was used. Exposes trust artifacts only, not internal generation logic.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

generated_test_id.description: The generated test id (or title) from orangepro_generate_tests.

tools.name: orangepro_export_evidence_pack
tools.description: Export a portable evidence pack (JSON) plus a human-readable Markdown summary for review or later hosted promotion. Includes facts, provenance, generated outputs, and high-level score metadata — never prompts, weights, traces, or raw source. Validates against the local schema.

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

include_generated_bodies.description: Embed generated test bodies in the pack. Default false: bodies stay in the local workspace so the exported pack is metadata-only. Raw source snippets never cross the boundary regardless of this flag.

graph_html.description: Also write a self-contained offline evidence-graph explorer (metadata only, no network).
